name: textscene-inspector
description: Preview Godot .tscn scenes in 3D and 2D inside VS Code, without a Godot install. Renders meshes, PBR materials, lights and cameras with three.js, and adds a scene tree, an inspector and a .tscn linter.

viewsWelcome.contents: Open a .tscn scene or its preview to see its node tree.

languageModelTools.name: textscene_lint
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Lint a Godot .tscn scene and return its diagnostics, each with a line, a severity, a message and a rule. Use after editing a scene, to check it without a Godot install. It reads an open editor's text, unsaved edits included.

path.description: The .tscn file: a workspace-relative path, or an absolute one.

languageModelTools.name: textscene_scene_tree
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Return a Godot .tscn scene's node tree as indented text, each node with its type. Use to understand a scene's structure without reading the raw file.

path.description: The .tscn file: a workspace-relative path, or an absolute one.

languageModelTools.name: textscene_open_preview
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Open the TextScene 3D/2D preview for a Godot .tscn scene beside the editor, so the user sees the scene render.

path.description: The .tscn file: a workspace-relative path, or an absolute one.

languageModelTools.name: textscene_missing_resources
languageModelTools.displayName: List a Godot .tscn scene's missing resources
languageModelTools.modelDescription: List the res:// resources a Godot .tscn scene references that the project does not hold.

path.description: The .tscn file: a workspace-relative path, or an absolute one.

languageModelTools.name: textscene_capture
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Render a Godot .tscn scene's preview and return it as a PNG image, so you can look at what a change produced. Needs VS Code 1.106 or later.

path.description: The .tscn file: a workspace-relative path, or an absolute one.

enumDescriptions: Match the Godot editor: pick 2D or 3D from the scene root's node type.
Always open new previews in the 2D viewport.
Always open new previews in the 3D viewport.
textscene.defaultViewportMode.description: The viewport a new preview opens in. "auto" follows the Godot editor: a CanvasItem root opens in 2D, and a Node3D root in 3D. "2D" and "3D" force that viewport. The 2D/3D toggle in each preview still works, and open previews keep their viewport until you reopen them.

textscene.diagnostics.enabled.description: Lint open .tscn files and report syntax and semantic issues in the Problems panel.

textscene.diagnostics.lintDebounceMs.description: Milliseconds to wait after the last edit before re-linting a .tscn document.

textscene.agentTools.enabled.description: Offer tools a coding agent in chat can call: lint a scene, read its node tree, open its preview, list its missing resources, and capture its preview. Turn off to hide them from agent tool lists. The change applies at once.

scripts.vscode:prepublish: pnpm --filter @textscene/core build && pnpm --filter @textscene/dev-kit build && pnpm build -- --skip-tests
scripts.pretest:integration: pnpm --filter @textscene/core build && pnpm --filter @textscene/dev-kit build && node esbuild.config.mjs && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json
scripts.pretest:installed: pnpm --filter @textscene/core build && pnpm --filter @textscene/dev-kit build && node esbuild.config.mjs && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json
scripts.pretest:web: pnpm --filter @textscene/core build && pnpm --filter @textscene/dev-kit build && node esbuild.config.mjs && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json
